Owner decision 2026-10-17 on the sibling-slot single-row CAS race (stage-1 finding F0): option 2, a bounded owner-side re-decide for resource-slot transitions. After a DEFINITIVE zero-row answer to a reserve/grant/release/close UPDATE, the ServiceDefinitionsOwner re-decides from a fresh authoritative observation and resubmits one exact-predicate UPDATE, at most SERVICE_INSTANCE_LIMIT.RESOURCES times; STATE_CHANGED remains the typed answer only when the bound is exhausted; the UNKNOWN (lost reply) path stays single-shot with one authoritative resolution and no resubmission; selection stays single-shot. Alternatives considered and declined: keep the typed hold + operation-owner re-drive (routine CLOSE_UNRESOLVED on group retirement, depends on the unwired production wake consumer), per-slot rows (breaks the single-row atomicity the successor fence relies on; schema and R2 contract reopening), leader grants the whole group (changes what a grant witnesses; leaves the retirement race), lifecycle-side retry (wrong owner; forbidden retry loop).
